title: Pending publish transaction fault injection
summary: Add deterministic pending-publish park/drain fault injection and conservative restart recovery at every transaction boundary.
reason: Current interruption windows can leave ambiguous final media, sidecar, completion-evidence, or cleanup state without sufficient manifest-backed reconciliation proof.
behavior_before: Pending publish had transactional partial-copy/reveal helpers but no uniform deterministic fault seam, no sidecar content hashes, and incomplete restart reconciliation for ambiguous post-sidecar, post-reveal, completion-evidence, and cleanup interruptions.
behavior_after: Pending park/drain boundaries are deterministically fault-testable; manifests retain media and sidecar proof plus transaction phase; restart recovery is idempotent and leaves uncertainty explicitly pending/review-bound.
rollback_plan: Revert only the files listed in this packet, restoring the prior pending-publish transaction helpers and tests; do not alter operator state or real pending-publish manifests during rollback.
notes:
All campaign fixtures use isolated temporary source, scratch, pending, destination, and state roots with tiny synthetic artifacts. Real-media deferred-publish-to-drain validation remains required if production behavior changes.
Add red transaction-boundary fault and idempotence checks.
